script:
set -eu
if [ ! -x bin/dev ]; then
  echo "Missing or non-executable bin/dev" >&2
  exit 1
fi
grep -qxF '.fabro/tmp/' .git/info/exclude 2>/dev/null || printf '.fabro/tmp/\n' >> .git/info/exclude
PATH="$PWD/bin:$PATH" dev sandbox-check
command:
exec 2>&1

  exit 1
fi
grep -qxF '.fabro/tmp/' .git/info/exclude 2>/dev/null || printf '.fabro/tmp/\n' >> .git/info/exclude
PATH="$PWD/bin:$PATH" dev sandbox-check
